what: live-vs-simulated seed baseline on the trading family (10 hold-out tasks)
why: every number in the suite comes from the simulated policy; this is the evidence for how far they transfer to a real model
calibration: the simulator is calibrated to the baselines the paper reports (BFCL-Miss 53.8%, BFCL-Base 77.3%, BIRD-style SQL 52.5%) so the suite is comparable to the paper. The local model is stronger than the paper models on this family.
reading: the live model already solves this family, so the headroom the simulator measures there is real headroom a real model does not have. Rankings (which method isolates learning) transfer; magnitudes do not, and on families a real model has mastered the live plasticity will be near zero.
